Notes

没有骨气

Literally “bone spirit,” 骨气 means backbone, integrity, or the courage to stand one’s ground. “Spineless” preserves a comparable bodily metaphor.

  • Genius community lyric text
腥味

腥 is the raw, fishy, or bloody smell of flesh. “Stench” carries the disgust; the Chinese image is more bodily than a generic bad odor.

  • Genius community lyric text
入戏太深

Literally becoming too deeply immersed in a dramatic role. It can describe being carried away by a performance or situation; the next line insists he remains clear-headed.

  • Genius community lyric text
独善其身

The idiom can mean preserving one’s own integrity, but also looking after oneself without concern for others. Beside the admission “selfish and conceited,” both shades remain available.

  • Genius community lyric text
目不转睛

Literally, not turning the eyes away: a fixed, concentrated stare. Earlier he threatens another person’s eyes; now he cannot stop looking at his own reflection. The repeated eye imagery organizes who gets to look, and who gets admired.

  • Genius community lyric text
胃口

胃口 means appetite and can also suggest how much someone wants or demands. Claiming only a small appetite while still fearing hunger puts insecurity beneath the extravagant self-admiration and red-carpet fantasy.

  • Genius community lyric text
